title: Reverted To Pages Dev (Safe Rollback)
style: safe revert anthem, 84 bpm, controlled retreat, deadpan ops, ssl mystery vibe, dry pad, ledger groove, terminal hum, certbot waiting
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
DNS A record swap to five one eight nine
One four three one seven zero VDS line
CF connects origin via SSL Full mode strict
VDS has no cert request fell through district

[Pre-Chorus]
Wrong vhost served the swap got reverted
CNAME back to pages dev the placeholder asserted

[Chorus]
Reverted reverted DNS held the line
Certbot needs operator approval to align
SSL mode at CF unknown to read
Token can't see what the zone needs

[Verse 2]
Cache purge attempted authentication error
Dev mode toggle authentication terror
SSL mode read unauthorized again
Four API calls four blockers in the pen

[Bridge]
Safe revert holds the placeholder steady
Path C waits for operator ready

[Outro]
Reverted reverted the line is clean
No phantom serving no broken scene
